_about: Text that replaces the API spec's wording in the generated files. Use only when the spec conflicts with a settled rule or is docs-UI text; every entry says why. Remove an entry when the spec is fixed.

bots_createBot.text: Send a bot to a Zoom, Google Meet or Microsoft Teams meeting, now or at join_at.
bots_createBot.why: The spec text describes the docs page UI (a dropdown), not the endpoint.

zoom.text: Zoom options. Recommended: set up and configure your own Zoom app (Integrations > Zoom) for reliable, fully supported Zoom bots; meetings outside that app's account need zak_url or obf_url.
zoom.why: Sid, 25 Nov 2026: recommend the Zoom app for reliable, full official support. The spec's 'join without your app or credentials' wording is replaced; the no-app join is a limited US-only fallback (see use_own_app).

zoom.use_own_app.text: true: require your Zoom app (recommended; 400 without one). false: join without it as an ordinary participant, US region only, no OBF/ZAK and no per-participant camera video. Omitted: your app when one is saved, else the US-only fallback.
zoom.use_own_app.why: States the code's behaviour (settled 25 Nov 2026) with the Zoom app as the recommended path.

live_video_required.text: Not implemented on meeting bots: accepted, ignored, and it moves the bot to the larger video tier. Do not send it; only Zoom RTMS sessions stream video.
live_video_required.why: Code (25 Nov 2026): every meeting bot ignores it; the spec says not implemented without the cost side effect.

recording_config.retention.text: How long media is kept. Omitted: kept permanently until you delete it. type timed with hours (default 720) deletes it automatically; the clock starts when the call is billed.
recording_config.retention.why: Code (25 Nov 2026): permanent default; the usage page's 30 days is wrong.
